terms.definition: Radiation around us all the time from natural sources (rocks, cosmic rays) and man-made sources (fallout, nuclear accidents).
terms.examiner: Separate Physics. Subtract it from count rates.

terms.definition: Measured in sieverts (Sv); how much harm the radiation could do.
A short half-life gamma emitter put into the body to show how an organ works.
terms.examiner: Separate Physics. Short half-life so it does not stay active in the body.

terms.definition: Using radiation to destroy unwanted tissue such as cancer cells.
terms.examiner: Separate Physics. The dose must target the tumour and limit damage to healthy cells.
